'''Category:Workstation''' collects the demo pages whose subject is the
workstation service of the stack and the operations around it: its standard
configuration and plugin set, the deployment and release cycle, the container
mount map, the backup and restore flow, and the compatibility seam the plugin set
sits on.

These pages are derived from the omniagent wiki under
<code>Projects/Omniagent/</code> and <code>Reference/Omniagent/</code>. Each page
ends with the exact source path it came from.

== Members ==

* [[Workstation Standard Config]] - the active, disabled and overridden plugin rows
* [[Trinity Deploy]] - the three-task Omniagent release cycle
* [[Workstation Compat Layer]] - the native plugin set and the retired shim
* [[Container Mount Map]] - host and container paths, and their translation
* [[Deployment Checklist]] - the compose deployment steps
* [[Backup and Restore]] - the toolbox backup, checkpoint and restore flow

== Related categories ==

* [[:Category:Omniagent|Category:Omniagent]] - the Omniagent platform pages
* [[:Category:Templates|Category:Templates]] - the reusable page shapes
